repos.summary_en: yt-dlp is a highly feature-rich command-line audio and video downloader supporting thousands of global websites. It offers powerful format selection, extensive post-processing options like metadata modification and subtitle downloading, and robust cross-platform capabilities, making it the ultimate tool for automated media retrieval and archiving.

Leveraging advanced browser scripting, the tool automates the parsing of genuine download addresses, effectively bypassing page redirects and standard speed limits. By simplifying the link resolution process, it significantly enhances download efficiency, serving as a powerful automation tool for users who require rapid and seamless cloud resource retrieval on a daily basis, helping to streamline personal workflows.

repos.summary_en: This self-hosted, open-source solution provides a powerful API for scraping Douyin and TikTok, delivering clean, watermark-free video and image downloads directly from platform sources. Easily deployable via Docker Compose, it features an async REST API, MCP integration, CLI, and an intuitive web console. Leveraging a self-healing identity pool and robust PostgreSQL archiving, it supports comprehensive data extraction for posts, profiles, comments, and search queries, ideal for developers seeking reliable, large-scale social media data collection and automated workflow integration.

It features batch collection, multi-account management, data persistence, and Web UI interaction. Built with Python and Docker, it offers proxy support, multi-threading, and resumable downloads for content archiving and data analysis.

It offers desktop app, Docker deployment, and browser extension, with AI assistant integration and HTTP API for automated downloading and format conversion, no complex setup required.

It allows users to seamlessly stream and download movies, TV series, and anime in high definition, leveraging fast, multithreaded downloading technology. Featuring intuitive subtitle download tools, a highly customizable interface, and a comprehensive personal library for tracking watched content, it also offers daily trending discovery. Streambert ensures a fast, private, and highly customizable offline entertainment solution for every global media lover.

Features include local playlist management, cookie-based login, and extensive lossless audio format support for superior playback quality.

It features batch downloading, streaming transfers, and chat monitoring. With integrated yt-dlp and Aria2 support, it enables automated collection and organization of media from Telegram and over 1,000 websites.
